25 October source-label reconciliation: The fully opened official École Mohammadia d'Ingénieurs governance page explicitly identifies the school as affiliated with Université Mohammed V de Rabat. Its current governance list identifies a Département Génie Industriel. The full EMI doctoral cycle page confirms doctorate supervision and thesis defense at the school. This imported school label should be associated with the existing university provider, not added as another independent university or duplicate doctoral route.
